cohort: The study included 186 individuals (143 boys and 43 girls) with a diagnosis of ASD, ranging in chronological age from 3 to 25 years, in an Algerian population.
finding: Insomnia (36.6%) and attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (13%) were identified as the main comorbidities associated with autism, and the clinical features and comorbidities of ASD in the study group were similar to those observed globally.
